d: 43 T20Is in one calendar year, and India are still expected to keep performing at highest level. England tour, Zimbabwe series, Asian Games, West Indies, now New Zealand - the gaps between tours just keep shrinking. Sanju Samson has admitted the team barely gets time to even practise, and Sunil Gavaskar and Morne Morkel have both flagged how brutal this calendar is getting. Travel, jet lag, no real recovery time. At what point does it become too much? Rupha Ramani looks at the cost of India's non-stop cricket schedule.
